in_sanskrit.name: असवरी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अस- (as) + वर- (var) + ई (i) - one not, without + वर् (var) + ई (i) - joy, sorrow - Without sorrow

in_hindi.name: असवरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अस- (as) + वर- (var) + ई (i) - one not, without + शद- (shad) + ई (i) - sound - Inaudible, without a sound

in_tamil.name: அசவரி
in_tamil.long_meaning: அ- (a) + ச- (ca) + வ- (va) + ர- (ra) + ி- (i) + ய- (y) + ி- (i) - one without, absence of + க- (ka) + ை- (ai) - sorrow, grief

in_telugu.name: అసవరి
in_telugu.long_meaning: అ- (a) + స- (sa) + వ- (va) + ర- (ra) + ి- (i) - one not, without + య- (y) - having, possessing - Free from, without

in_marathi.name: Asavari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Free from sorrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asavari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘asu’, meaning ‘life’ and ‘vri’, meaning ‘free from’. In Hindu mythology, Asavari is the name of a goddess, representing freedom from sorrow and suffering.
